articles.title: A 3,400-Year-Old Folding Chair Found in a Danish Grave
articles.summary: A super old folding chair was found in a chief's grave in Denmark. It's the only one from Bronze Age Europe that's still whole. Cool, right?

articles.title: Tennis Star Coco Gauff Says Rival Has More Pressure Than Her
articles.summary: Coco Gauff says tennis player Alexandra Eala has more pressure because she's the first Filipino to do so much. Eala is a big deal in her country!

articles.title: Can We Find Secret Nuclear Weapons in Space?
articles.summary: Nuclear weapons are banned in space, but nobody can check. A new idea uses satellites to sniff out hidden bombs. Could it work?
